Slide:
Script:
Pauses:
Final revision:

title: Recover from a revision conflict and verify replay
prompt:
Using DEKS, exercise revision and idempotency safety on exactly the presentation “Reviewer — Test B”, slide “Test B”, target element “Test B title”. First read its current state. Intentionally attempt to change its content to “Safe revision recovered” with expected revision 0 and idempotency key “review-v041-stale-test-b”. After the revision conflict, re-read the presentation, apply that same intended content at the current revision with the new key “review-v041-title-test-b”, then repeat that exact successful request once with the same key to verify idempotent replay. Re-read the final state. End with exactly these five labeled lines:
Conflict:
Committed revision:
Replay revision:
Total revision advance:
Final content:
expected_behavior: Call list_presentations, get_presentation and get_slide_state before writing
Receive revision_conflict from update_element_identity at expected revision 0 without mutation
Re-read, call update_element_identity at revision 1 with the new key, then replay the exact successful request with the same key
Return revision 2 for both the committed response and its replay, advance exactly once and preserve final content Safe revision recovered
fixture: After the reviewer reset, Reviewer — Test B is at revision 1; slide Test B contains element Test B title (test-b-title) with content Test B, and neither test idempotency key has a receipt.

Initial status:
Published:
Public link:
Revision:

Embedded instruction:
Secrets disclosed:
Revision:
